mentions.name: Xeil
mentions.description: This app is a PDF reader with dark mode and proper image support, featuring vimium-style (vim-like) keyboard navigation. It has been in personal use for several months and has now been published.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been building a PDF reader with dark mode that supports image properly with vimimum navigations. Been using it for the past few months and really happy with the result. Finally got around to publishing it here: https://github.com/moomou/xeil
